How to use it

  1. Open START-HERE.pdf. It is one page and tells you which letter to use.
  2. Find the reason on the chargeback banner of the order in your Shopify admin. Open the Word letter for that reason.
  3. Fill in the brackets with facts from your own records. Delete any line you cannot back with a file.
  4. Attach the files on the checklist and send it in Shopify before the due date shown on the chargeback.

Stuck? Email your filled-in letter to kaiventura.founder@gmail.com before you submit (remove card numbers and anything you don't want to share). We'll tell you what's missing for your reason, usually within one working day. Free. Not legal advice.

Which letter

The letters follow the reason names Shopify shows on a chargeback. Each reason has a free guide, a template and the evidence list.

  • Fraudulent or unrecognized
  • Product not received
  • Product unacceptable or not as described
  • Subscription canceled
  • Duplicate
  • Credit not processed
  • Also covered: General, inquiries, Shopify Protect orders and orders that were already refunded.

A real case, before and after

From our test 02: a fraud dispute where the merchant had a text thread with the customer ("yes great, leave them outside the door if we are not home") and a photo of the parcel at the door.

Before. The merchant sent the texts and the photo as proof of delivery, and lost. Proof of delivery does not answer a fraud claim. The bank wants to know whether the cardholder approved the payment.

After. The kit starts with a verdict: weak, so fight only if it is cheap to do. It explains that the texts and photo show the person the merchant dealt with got the goods, which is not the same as showing the cardholder approved the charge, and it lists what on the order page would move the case up to Fight.

Who this is for, and who it is not

A good fit
  • You handle a few disputes a month and can put the evidence together yourself.
  • You want to choose which disputes to fight.
  • Your orders are large enough that a percentage of what you win hurts.
  • You would rather not give anyone access to your store.
Look at a recovery service or an alerts tool instead if
  • You mainly need alerts that let you refund before a dispute opens. A kit answers a dispute, it does not prevent one.
  • You want the work done for you, or you have dozens of disputes a month.
  • Your chargeback rate is a problem for Shopify or your processor. A kit does not fix an account.

Services take a percentage of recovered money or a monthly fee; the comparison table has the prices we could verify, and seven apps are compared on their own page. Where a number is a rough guide rather than something a source states, such as how many disputes a month suit doing it yourself, treat it as one.

Install

  1. Unzip the download. It holds the chargeback-response-writer folder, ready-made zips for claude.ai in a claude-ai folder, a README and the licence.
  2. Put the chargeback-response-writer folder where your assistant looks for skills. The generic path is .agents/skills/ (or npx skills add from a folder). Tool-specific paths:
    • Claude Code: ~/.claude/skills/ (or .claude/skills/ inside one project)
    • OpenAI Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and others: .agents/skills/ or the skills folder their docs name
    • claude.ai: Customize, Skills, then the plus button, Create skill, Upload a skill, and upload the zip from the claude-ai folder without unzipping it (code execution must be on in Settings, Capabilities)
    • ChatGPT or any chatbot: open the skill's prompt.md, paste it into the chat, then paste your own text or link
    • Steps for each tool, with links to its official docs: how to install Agent Skills
  3. Ask for the job in plain words, for example: "I got a chargeback, reason Fraudulent, $450. Here is the order and the evidence I have: ...". The skill loads by itself.
